description: This Java class, JwtTokenProvider, is a utility component within a Spring Boot application responsible for generating, extracting information from, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) used for authentication purposes.

classes.name: JwtTokenProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods for generating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens based on user authentication data.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token using the authenticated user's details, setting the subject, issue time, expiration, and signing it with a secret key.

methods.name: getUsernameFromToken
methods.description: Extracts and returns the username (subject) from a given JWT token.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Checks the validity of a JWT token, returning true if valid, false if invalid or expired.
